profile.headline: Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer | React, TypeScript, Design Systems | Platform Architecture | Open to Full-Time Roles + Consulting Engagements
profile.jobTitle: Lead Software Engineer and Chief Technology Officer
profile.summary:
Frontend software engineer since 2012. I've spent that time building the systems other engineers build on top of, and the products people actually use.

Most recently at USAFacts, I led the planning of a design system used across the site and built the Asset Generation Service, a Node.js microservice that powers our chart rendering assets (SVG, image, CSV) in production today.

Before that, at Arrived, I built a shared component library from scratch in Tamagui and NX that shipped to both web and React Native, cutting time-to-market by roughly 60% and boosting team productivity by about 40%. Earlier in my career I worked on consumer products at scale, including Alexa and Kindle Enterprise at Amazon.

I also run Miltinson Technologies, where I take ideas from concept to a shippable, A/B-testable product. If you're a founder or small team that needs a senior engineer who moves fast without cutting corners on architecture, that's the work I take on there.

I like frontend work that sits between architecture and product: strong component APIs and accessibility, grounded in what actually ships. I'm also building AI tooling into how teams work day to day, and looking for a place where that keeps growing.

Based in the Seattle area. Open to senior/staff IC roles and select consulting engagements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer and Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Turning ideas into code and running through the gambit of turning ideas into A/B testable products to put in front of users in under a week, measuring their success or failure quickly, and pulling the plug on ideas that don't sell.

Focusing on quality, security, efficiency, as well as speed by utilizing AI as a thought partner, designer, code reviewer, code writer, and maintaining appropriate HITL level of understanding.

NO VIBE CODING HERE!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Co-designed and built the Asset Generation Service, a Node.js microservice that renders chart data to PNG, SVG, and CSV via headless Chromium.
 
* Led a fleet-wide GitHub Actions modernization, upgrading 17 repositories to Node 24 after scoping the EOL surface area in a dedicated spike.
 
* Debugged, deep-dived, and resolved a Kubernetes crash-loop Datadog error that had plagued on-call for six months, then verified weekly for three weeks afterward that it was fully gone.
 
* Established automated functional and smoke testing for the squad: affected-file runs on pre-push, functional tests on the branch workflow, replacing manual regression checks.
 
* Tech lead for the USAFacts Design System; authored the PRD and TDD to give multi-repo products a shared, on-brand component foundation. (core components built; full GA in progress as of June 2026)
 
* Created skills to optimize engineering workflows, including JIRA task creation, code descriptions, code reviewing, code-review comment verification, and AGENTS.md file optimization. Shared widely across the engineering department, helped maintain the skills repo, and automated notifications to admins to update skills in Claude Org settings.
 
* Hardened secrets management with an Azure Key Vault feature-flag pattern, migrating from org-wide to repo-specific secrets and cycling exposed API keys.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Next.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Tailwind CSS · Builder.IO · Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Technical Design

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Contract through Accelon

* Optimized merchant integration success by monitoring analytics and identifying the PayPal Fastlane SDK trends, contributing to enhanced adoption and performance.

* Improved user experience and efficiency by maintaining and enhancing Stencil Web Components, implementing features like dark mode, and ensuring accessibility and bug-free functionality.

* Elevated team productivity by driving comprehensive documentation practices across codebases, readmes, and Confluence, ensuring consistent knowledge sharing and streamlined onboarding.

* Fostered team growth and excellence by mentoring junior engineers through detailed code reviews, pair programming, and collaborative knowledge-sharing initiative
positions.insights: Skills: StencilJS · Web Components · Jest · Playwright · NodeJS · Dark Mode

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
* Successfully launched a product-wide redesign in 2 months
* Managed two short-term, remote, non-US contractors and helped maintain the quality, timing, and delivery of their projects
* Teamed up with product to drive timelines, sprint work, prioritization, and deliveries.
positions.insights: Skills: Vercel · React.js · Next.js · PostgreSQL · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Prisma ORM · Chakra UI

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Oversaw a fully-remote, highly collaborative, group of 5 front-end engineers spanning 3 cross functional, cross platform teams with a wide range of engineering experience, innovating a system for concurrent mobile and web development, improving productivity by 40% in 9 months.
- Established team in charge of developing a user facing React Native iOS app with a launch crash rate of 0.01%, resulting in 37k installations and generating $6.2M revenue within one year.
- Initiated the design system which streamlined discussions between design and engineering teams, slashing meeting durations by ~30 minutes per meeting. Time between product kick-off to feature launch was reduced, on average, from 3 to 2 months.
- Migrated 249 posts and 49 webinars from a compromised WordPress blog to a modern CMS (Builder.io) in 1 month, reducing time till first draw for customers by 8 seconds on average.
- Implemented multiple A/B test cases using Growthbook to test more efficient performance of product initiatives. Measured success using accounts created, dollars invested, and return users. Oversaw tests which brought 8% growth in 2 months.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
- Managed IT department during company growth from 6 to 65 employees in 3 years. Assume this role to save Arrived money and maintain uninterrupted workflow for all employees.
- Enforced security best practices company-wide, enabling forced multifactor authentication across >28 essential tools.
- Achieved annual savings of $30,000 through strategic software cost negotiations and research initiatives, a 22% savings.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)

positions.description:

- Founded CI/CD pipeline, enabling deployment from dev to prod within 10 minutes. Automated essential safety checks, such as unit and end-to-end tests, to ensure flawless operations.
- Led the redesign and re-implementation of the entire site using Mobile-First pattern to support multiple displays, resulting in a 58% increase in investor sign-up conversions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web
positions.description:

- Facilitated discussions between front-end and back-end teams to ensure effective utilization of client-side performance practices. Initiated dialogues among front-end teams to enhance the discoverability of shared code.
- Collaborated on the engineering planning committee to optimize end-to-end product/tech documentation workflow. Introduced new templates and patterns, reducing folder count by hundreds, verbosity per document by 33%, and time spent by 40% in 6 months.
